fields.name: VCU/CarState/home_mode
fields.doc: Whether or not VCU is in home mode.
fields.desc: In the firmware, this value corresponds to the value of the bool `get_nero_state().home_mode`.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/nero_index
fields.desc: In the firmware, this value corresponds to the value of `get_nero_state().nero_index`, which is of type `nero_menu_t`. 0=OFF, 1=PIT, 2=REVERSE, 3=PERFORMANCE, 4=EFFICIENCY, 5=GAMES, 6=EXIT. This description was last updated on 12/14/2025, so please modify it if there have been any changes in the firmware.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/speed
fields.doc: Speed of the car, in miles per hour.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/tsms
fields.doc: Whether or not shutdown is closed.
fields.desc: Refers to the "Official" TSMS state (not the raw pin state, but the state stored in the debounced 'tsms' bool).

fields.name: VCU/CarState/torque_limit_percentage
fields.doc: The torque limit selected by the driver.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/not_in_reverse
fields.doc: Whether or not the car is in reverse.
fields.desc: '1' means that `cerberus_state.functional != F_REVERSE`. '0' means that 'cerberus_state.functional == F_REVERSE'.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/regen_limit
fields.doc: The regenerative braking current limit (selected by the driver).

fields.name: VCU/CarState/launch_control
fields.doc: Whether or not launch control is enabled.
fields.desc: '1' indicates that launch control is enabled. '0' indicates that launch control is disabled.

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Percentages/acceleration_pedal
fields.doc: How far the acceleration pedal is pressed, ranging from 0 to 1.
fields.desc: '0' corresponds to 0% (pedal is not pressed down at all). '1' corresponds to 100% (pedal is pressed down as far as possible).

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Percentages/brake_pedal
fields.doc: How far the brake pedal is pressed, ranging from 0 to 1.
fields.desc: '0' corresponds to 0% (pedal is not pressed down at all). '1' corresponds to 100% (pedal is pressed down as far as possible).
